review_candidates.description: Do you want your voice heard and your actions to count? Discover your opportunity with Mitsubishi UFJ Financial Group (MUFG), one of the world’s leading financial groups. Across the globe, we’re 150,000 colleagues, striving to make a difference for every client, organization, and community we serve. We stand for our values, building long-term relationships, serving society, and fostering shared and sustainable growth for a better world. With a vision to be the world’s most trusted financial group, it’s part of our culture to put people first, listen to new and diverse ideas and collaborate toward greater innovation, speed and agility. This means investing in talent, technologies, and tools that empower you to own your career. Join MUFG, where being inspired is expected and making a meaningful impact is rewarded. MUFG bank is seeking an Analyst / Associate in Planning Department at Global Markets Division for Asia, based in Hong Kong. This is an exceptional opportunity for you to play a pivotal role in supporting the day-to-day operations and strategic planning of a highly respected business area. You will be part of a supportive team that values your input and encourages professional growth through exposure to regional projects and cross-border collaboration. If you are looking to develop your career within a nurturing environment where your interpersonal skills and commitment to excellence are truly valued, this position provides the perfect platform. Join a globally recognised financial institution with a strong presence across Asia, offering you the chance to work on impactful regional initiatives and collaborate with international teams. Be part of an inclusive workplace that values diversity, fosters open communication, and supports your growth through meaningful responsibilities and stakeholder engagement. What You'll Do As an Analyst / Associate in Planning Department at Global Markets Division for Asia, you will play an integral role in supporting both daily operations and long-term strategic initiatives. Your responsibilities will include coordinating essential business functions such as budgeting, forecasting, and reviewing internal control processes. You will work closely with the Planning Head on various projects aimed at enhancing operational efficiency and implementing regional strategies. Building strong relationships with stakeholders—both locally and internationally—will be central to your success in this role. You will also ensure that all activities comply fully with regulatory requirements by upholding ethical standards and assisting in policy development. In addition to regular reporting duties, you will have opportunities to participate in special projects that broaden your experience and contribute meaningfully to the division’s objectives. Coordinate and manage the daily operations of the Global Markets business area, ensuring all activities run smoothly and efficiently while maintaining high standards of accuracy. Support the Planning Head in developing comprehensive business strategies, contributing to business promotion planning, operational efficiency improvements, and the successful implementation of regional projects. Develop and maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders both internally across departments and externally with partners, fostering effective communication and collaboration. Partner closely with overseas branches and Head Office teams to support the creation and execution of robust business strategies for the Global Markets Division. Ensure full compliance with prevailing regulations by demonstrating ethical behaviour at all times and adhering strictly to all internal controls established for the team. Assist in developing, updating, and aligning departmental policies with relevant laws and regulations to ensure ongoing compliance across all activities. Take responsibility for preparing management or departmental reports, providing accurate information that supports decision-making processes within the division. Participate actively in ad hoc projects or assignments as required, contributing your insights and expertise to drive successful outcomes. What You Bring To excel the role of an Analyst / Associate in Planning Department at Global Markets Division for Asia, you will bring proven experience from either banking or financial services environments—or demonstrate strong academic credentials if you are early in your career. Your background equips you with practical knowledge of market trends, product offerings, regulatory frameworks, and best practices within financial institutions. You possess excellent organisational capabilities that help you manage complex tasks efficiently while maintaining attention to detail. Your interpersonal skills foster positive relationships with colleagues across different regions and cultures. Effective communication—especially fluency in both Japanese and English—enables you to share ideas clearly whether collaborating on projects or preparing reports. Above all, your proactive attitude ensures that you consistently seek ways to enhance operational effectiveness while upholding ethical standards. A university degree in Banking, Finance or a related discipline provides you with the foundational knowledge necessary for this role. At least 3 years’ relevant experience within banking or financial institutions is preferred; however, candidates who are recent graduates with an academic background in accounting are also encouraged to apply. A solid understanding of industry trends, global markets business practices, financial products, as well as relevant laws and regulations is essential for success. Your maturity enables you to approach tasks thoughtfully while being proactive in identifying areas for improvement within processes or strategies. The ability to work independently ensures you can manage responsibilities effectively while contributing positively within a team setting. Excellent organisational skills allow you to handle multiple priorities efficiently without compromising quality or deadlines. Strong communication abilities enable you to interact confidently with colleagues at all levels as well as external partners. A good command of written and spoken Japanese alongside English is required for effective communication across diverse teams. Mitsubishi UFJ Financial Group (MUFG) is an equal opportunity employer. We view our employees as our key assets as they are fundamental to our long-term growth and success. MUFG is committed to hiring based on merit and organsational fit, regardless of race, religion or gender.
